intro: Romania's economy has grown fast since joining the EU, with car factories, farms and a strong IT industry.

chapters.title: Cars and code
text: Dacia, owned by Renault, builds affordable cars in Romania, and Ford makes cars in Craiova. Romania has fast internet and a booming software sector; companies such as UiPath and Bitdefender started there.

chapters.title: Farms and energy
text: Romania is one of the EU's biggest growers of wheat, maize and sunflowers, and it has oil and gas, with a large new gas field being developed under the Black Sea.

keyTerms.meaning: Businesses that make software and digital services.
